card.name: The word oral before drug terms
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "oral" (also "Oral") right before a noun such as intake, glucose test, antidiabetic or medications. Also fires on some word endings like -ity in non-inferiority and -al in withdrawal.

modes.description: The word oral comes just before a drug or intake term in label text.

card.writes: It seems to push away hyphenated suffixes like -style, -type and -based, so a plain noun is expected next.
card.plain: It marks the word "oral" in phrases like oral intake or oral medications, where a plain noun follows.
